mechanism_plain_english: Overview & Scrutiny can call in specified GMCA, mayoral-general-function and delegated decisions and require members/officers to explain decisions/performance. This does not apply automatically: the Sep 2025 Culture Fund decision was explicitly not subject to call-in.

Overview & Scrutiny membership comes from constituent-authority elected members and other regional groups. Published rules: 10 members can call in a mayoral/CA decision within five working days; CA can affirm/reject and refer back if rejected; immediate decisions can be excluded. Audit & Governance is separate.

Scrutiny Committee is cross-party backbench councillors; 17 members in 2026, chaired by Cllr Bob Felstead. Can call in/delay decisions, require Mayor/members/officers, request information, review and recommend; cannot itself make/block CA decisions. New powers from Apr 2027 include two scrutiny officers, petitions, expert pool and VFM assessments.

Local Scrutiny Committee operating in 2026; Cllr Edward Fitter appointed Chair in July; committee reviewed Integrated Settlement Annual Report. Exact powers must be read with 2026 Act and WMCA constitution, not inferred from title.
